question: ‘Agenda 21’ was a set of practices recommended at the ________.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Rio Summit, 1992.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• It is a result of the **Earth Summit (UN Conference on Environment and Development)** held in **Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**, in 1992.
